# 03_Summary

## Purpose

Stores raw text, summaries, chunks, caches, and agent prompts.

## Subdirectories

| Directory | Content | Generated By |
|-----------|---------|--------------|
| `raw_text/` | Extracted plain text from PDFs | `pdf_parser.py` |
| `summaries/` | Generated summary markdown files | `summary_agent.py` / `summary_engine.py` |
| `chunks/` | Text chunks for embedding | `chunker.py` |
| `cache/` | Summary cache (JSON) | Summary Engine |
| `failures/` | Failure logs | Summary Engine |
| `agent_prompts/` | Agent mode prompt files | `summary_agent.py` |

## Auto-Generated Content

All content in all subdirectories is auto-generated.

## User Editing

**No** — all content is auto-generated by the pipeline.
